purpose: Diagnose the time-localization of the PFFDTD dense sub-band worsening pattern: apply a small frozen set of predeclared causal time gates to the bound raw pressure records of the three canonical PFFDTD levels, re-derive the finite-record transfers on the unchanged 34-frequency dense grid under the same metric/pairs/thresholds, and record whether the 10->12 worsening is carried by early staircase-mediated record energy or is broadband across the record. Evaluation-only: no solver executions beyond the canonical binding legs and no new solver state are produced. Predeclared verbatim by docs/R130D_GENERAL3D_VOXEL_STAIRCASE_SENSITIVITY_RESULT_2026-10-03.md as the next pre-fixed numerical experiment.

run76_record_binding.binding_rule: the canonical cell evaluates the same persisted pressure/source records as authoritative run #76; a run that re-executes the pinned PFFDTD contract binds to those records by comparing the semantic sha256 of the recombined pressure trace and the unit discrete volume-velocity impulse source trace at every predeclared PPW level; every gate cell is a pure re-evaluation of those bound records and carries no new trace digests
run76_record_binding.on_nonidentical: the computed sweep values are still emitted, but evaluation_state becomes NOT_EVALUATED_RECORD_BINDING_MISMATCH and the frozen classification is withheld so the result cannot be read as the run-76 experiment

time_gate_localization.axis: time-localization of the dense sub-band worsening: apply the frozen causal time-gate set to each bound raw pressure record and re-derive the finite-record transfer per gate; geometry, cartesian grid, boundary/staircase representation, source/receiver stencils and injected signals, materials, time sampling, duration, and the scored contract are unchanged, and no solver state is re-executed

gating_convention.record: the bound physical pressure record derived from the canonical leg's persisted velocity-potential output by the frozen p=rho*d(phi)/dt second-order conversion; gates act on this record, not on solver state
gating_convention.interval_semantics: a gate g=[t_start_s,t_end_s) is a half-open interval over the canonical record [0,T); at each level the gate selects the samples n for which t_start_s <= n*Ts < t_end_s on that level's own solver time grid
gating_convention.application: the gated record equals the bound pressure record inside the gate and is zero outside it; the unchanged dt-weighted direct-frequency analysis transform (analysis kernel exp(+i*omega*t), time grid n*Ts over [0,T)) is applied to the gated record
gating_convention.source_normalization: the unit-impulse source spectrum is never gated: every gate divides by the unchanged full-record source spectrum, so the gates of a disjoint partition of [0,T) decompose the canonical transfer additively
gating_convention.determinism: gate intervals are declared in absolute seconds and evaluated on each level's own time step; no taper, smoothing, amplitude fitting, or frequency-grid change is permitted

gates.rule: the unchanged record [0,T): the control cell that reproduces the canonical dense worsening vector and binds the run-76 records
causal prefix truncation: keep only the first 10 ms - the direct arrival (~2.9 ms at the frozen 1.0 m source-receiver separation) plus the first wall reflections
causal prefix truncation: keep only the first 25 ms - direct plus the early first-order reflection train
causal prefix truncation: keep only the first 50 ms - direct plus early reflections
causal prefix truncation: keep only the first 100 ms - direct, early reflections, and the early decay buildup
complementary tail: drop the first 10 ms (direct and first reflections) and keep the remainder of the record
complementary tail: drop the first 25 ms and keep the remainder of the record
complementary tail: drop the first 50 ms (direct and early reflections) and keep the remainder of the record
complementary tail: drop the first 100 ms and keep only the late half of the record
interior band: keep only the mid-record reflection buildup between 50 and 150 ms
interior band: keep only the late diffuse tail between 150 and 250 ms

execution.solver_executions: none beyond the three canonical binding legs: each gate re-evaluates the bound raw record of an already-executed canonical leg; no boundary, stencil, source, or receiver variant is re-run and no new solver state is produced
execution.canonical_cell_rule: reuse the canonical leg outputs that bind run76_record_binding
execution.contract_invariant: every evaluated gate reads the canonical leg's persisted sim assets (u_out, out_alpha, Ts, Nt) and the re-derived bound pressure record must reproduce the pinned run-76 pressure/source trace digests before any gated evaluation
execution.partition_identity: for every level, the prefix_50ms + band_mid_50_150ms + band_late_150_250ms gated transfers must sum to the control transfer within the frozen 1e-12 max-abs-component tolerance; a violation blocks the diagnostic as fail-closed

rejected_axes.axis: non-causal or tapered window shapes (Tukey/Hann/half-cosine edges)
rejected_axes.reason: a shaped window re-weights samples inside the gate and would confound time-localization with spectral-leakage shaping; gates are binary half-open interval masks only

rejected_axes.axis: gating the injected source record per-gate (normalized-per-gate transfer)
rejected_axes.reason: a gate that excludes t=0 has a zero injected record and an undefined P/Q ratio; dividing each gated record by the unchanged full-record source spectrum is the only convention that keeps the additive partition identity

rejected_axes.axis: sub-record reslicing or re-origin of the time axis inside a gate
rejected_axes.reason: re-origin t-prime=t-t0 multiplies the gated spectrum by a pure phase and breaks the additive decomposition of the canonical transfer; gates are evaluated on the original solver time grid

rejected_axes.axis: new solver executions or persisted-record substitution
rejected_axes.reason: the axis is declared evaluation-only over the bound run-76 records; any solver re-run other than the canonical binding legs is out of scope

evaluation.frequency_grid_ref: the dense_frequency_neighborhood band grid of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan (34 frequencies, 36.0-44.0/76.0-84.0 Hz at 0.5 Hz)
evaluation.worsening_rule: worsening at frequency f iff d_10_12(f) > d_8_10(f); the complete predeclared grid is evaluated for every cell with no post-result selection

per_cell_classification.rule: the dense worsening-count thresholds of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan applied to each cell independently

evaluation.carries_worsening_rule: a gate carries the worsening iff its worsening count exceeds localized_max_count, i.e. its per-cell dense classification is MIXED or PERSISTS rather than LOCALIZED
evaluation.pattern_metric: per-cell 34-frequency worsening vector compared to the canonical cell's vector; hamming_distance = count of frequencies whose worsening bit differs

partition_identity_check.rule: the three disjoint partition gated transfers must sum to the control transfer per level within max_abs_complex_component_tolerance

classification.rule: evaluate in order: (1) invariant iff every evaluated non-control cell reproduces the canonical worsening vector exactly; (2) early_carried iff every tail cell is localized and at least one prefix cell reproduces the canonical vector exactly; (3) late_carried iff every prefix cell is localized and at least one tail cell reproduces the canonical vector exactly; (4) broadband iff at least one prefix cell carries and at least one tail cell carries; (5) otherwise mixed
